rows.label: Animals spared per meat meal replaced (ACE, 2024)

source.title: ACE, Dansk Vegetarisk Forening cost-effectiveness sheet (2024)

rows.explainer: ACE's average number of farmed animals no longer raised when one meat meal is replaced by a plant-based one. Low and high are ACE's bounds.

rows.label: SADs averted per meat meal replaced (ACE, 2024)

source.title: ACE, Dansk Vegetarisk Forening cost-effectiveness sheet (2024)

rows.explainer: ACE's suffering-adjusted days averted when one meat meal is replaced, for the same meals as the animals-spared figure. Low and high are ACE's bounds.

rows.label: SADs in one year of a battery-caged hen's life

source.title: Ambitious Impact SADs, via ACE's Sinergia Animal sheet (2025)

rows.explainer: Ambitious Impact's suffering-adjusted days for a year in a battery cage (11.5 in an aviary). ACE notes the SADs values have since been updated.

rows.label: Animals spared per leaflet (ACE, 2016)

source.title: ACE, Albert Schweitzer Foundation Guesstimate model (2016)

rows.explainer: From ACE's leafleting calculator, scaled to German meat consumption. Excludes shellfish and wild fish. ACE later cautioned that the studies behind its leafleting estimates were weak, so treat this as a generous figure for a light-touch contact.

rows.label: Years of farmed-animal life spared per leaflet (ACE, 2016)

source.title: ACE, Albert Schweitzer Foundation Guesstimate model (2016)

rows.explainer: ACE's companion figure to animals spared per leaflet: about 0.28 years, or roughly 100 days, of factory-farmed life per animal spared.

rows.label: Animals spared per week-long vegan pledge participant (ACE, 2016)

source.title: ACE, Albert Schweitzer Foundation Guesstimate model (2016)

rows.explainer: ACE's estimate for a participant in Vegan Taste Week, assumed a quarter as effective as Veganuary's month-long pledge. ACE calls it extremely crude.

rows.label: Animals spared per social media video watched to the end (ACE, 2016)

source.title: ACE, HSUS Farm Animal Protection Campaign Guesstimate model (2016)

rows.explainer: ACE's 0.65 animals spared per dollar of social media spending, times about $0.032 per video watched to 95% ($16,500 for 518,000 views). ACE's Albert Schweitzer Foundation model gives about 0.024.
